title: helperContract
responsibility: Decides whether a reviewed pure helper has at least two distinct actual consumers.

inputs.name: helperContract.helper
inputs.description: The reviewed helper's declared contract, the sole input to each eligibility check: only pure and consumers are read, pure must be exactly true, and each consumers entry names a unit with an optional symbol. A missing pure value is never read as true, and a missing consumers list counts as zero consumers, so either one makes the result false.

outputs.name: helperContract
outputs.description: This is the eligibility result shared by all renderers: true only when helper.pure is exactly true and the consumers list has at least two distinct unit and symbol pairs. A missing symbol is keyed as an empty string, so repeated entries with the same unit and symbol count once, and the result is always a boolean.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: The function throws a TypeError when helper is null or undefined (helper.pure is read without a guard), when consumers is a value other than null or undefined that has no map method, or when a consumers entry is null or undefined (consumer.unit is read without a guard). These values fall outside the declared CallableContract type.
